purpose: Opt-in smoke test for the currently observed Dragon Realm start screen. This profile is not a universal control mapping.

actions.purpose: Start a new game from the visible menu button

verification_limits: A sent browser input is not proof the game accepted it.
A visual difference alone does not establish causality.
Compare player position, scene state, HUD, and OCR before attributing behavior.
Do not use this profile for other projects.
